goal: Prevent node aborts and integer overflows when importing descriptors with ranges ending near 2^31-1
Safely reject out-of-bounds descriptor ranges and handle boundary keypool refills without crashing
agreement: Broad support with multiple reviewers verifying fixes against master crashes (jeanpablojp, molnard, kriss39)
Minor suggestions for tests, release notes, and related checks addressed by author (jeanpablojp, polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it fixes node crashes triggered by boundary-case descriptor imports
Prevents signed integer overflow that inverts keypool ranges and aborts wallet operations
